instruction: Add all the songs from Lily Moon that have been played over 980 times to my Spotify player queue.
notes: Single-app Spotify task. Login username is the supervisor email (obtained via supervisor.show_profile, modeled by (profile-known)) and the password comes from show_account_passwords. The artist id is discovered by search_artists (known-id), then one search_songs call (query + artist_id + min_play_count=980) reveals all qualifying songs, modeled by (songs-found artist threshold); the agent must still filter for play_count strictly > 980. The number of qualifying songs is unknown a priori, so three placeholder song objects are used; they are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can state the full goal conjunction (all qualifying songs in-queue) without quantification. At runtime the add_to_queue step is repeated once per song returned by search_songs with play_count > 980. Only the music player queue changes; existing queue songs are untouched (no clear_song_queue).
